title: GTA 6 Has No 60 FPS Mode, Not Even on PS5 Pro
short_title: GTA 6 has no 60 FPS mode. Not even PS5 Pro #GTA6 #Shorts
short_title_options: GTA 6 has no 60 FPS mode. Not even PS5 Pro #GTA6 #Shorts
Why GTA 6 can't run 60 FPS on PS5 Pro #GTA6 #Shorts
PS5 Pro owners, GTA 6 has bad news for you #GTA6 #Shorts
short_description: Rockstar's technology production director Marc Chambers told Kotaku the PS5 Pro's processor "is not powerful enough to run the game's complex simulation at higher framerates". GTA 6 targets 30 FPS on PS5, PS5 Pro and Xbox Series X|S; 40 and 60 FPS modes are ruled out on current consoles. PS5 Pro adds ray-traced shadows and PSSR for a sharper image. Sources: PC Gamer, Beebom, Wccftech, Insider Gaming (Nov 2026). Footage: official Rockstar trailers.

short_es.title: GTA 6 NO tiene 60 FPS... ni en PS5 Pro 😬 #GTA6 #Shorts
short_es.description: Marc Chambers, director de producción tecnológica de Rockstar, dijo a Kotaku que el procesador de la PS5 Pro no es lo bastante potente para la simulación del juego a más fotogramas. GTA 6 va a 30 FPS en PS5, PS5 Pro y Xbox Series X|S; no habrá modos de 40 ni 60 FPS en las consolas actuales. La PS5 Pro suma sombras con trazado de rayos y una imagen más nítida.

short.headline: ROCKSTAR: THE CPU
short.text: Rockstar told Kotaku the Pro's processor isn't powerful enough for the game's simulation. Forty FPS is ruled out too.
